title: E-FRC-0289: 't Hooft anomaly matching for a light three-member electron on the register rule, fail as derived: on...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0289 in the gauge arena: 't Hooft anomaly matching for a light three-member electron on the register rule, fail as derived: on one chiral face the constituents (per tone an SU(2)+ doublet of colour 3, Q -1/3 and +1/3) cancel every Q coefficient and Witten's parity, so $U(1)_Q$ and $U(1)_Q$ x SU(2)+ are vacuous, and with member number the constituents give $\operatorname{Tr} N^3 = \operatorname{Tr} N = 12$ while every colour-singlet composite has N = 3, so its $\operatorname{Tr} N^3$ is 9 times its Tr N: none of 5,764,801 index assignments over the 8 J = 1/2 composite multiplets matches, no anomaly protects a light composite electron, and blocker 2 becomes a rule change on tone.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
